final_message: Simplified dct-index-rulebook.md by removing shared operational rules and pointing to the common sources. Resolved F001 with the min_size explanation. Non-whitespace characters 6269 -> 4997 (about 79.7%). Prettier and markdownlint pass for the file.
handoff: Non-whitespace character count of dct-index-rulebook.md: before 6269, after 4997 (about 79.7%).

Renamed the chapter from 「位置づけと用語定義」 to 「位置づけ」 because the terminology table only restated the body requirements. Only the definition of `domain` as a logical management unit remains. Required and conditional classifications did not change.

Removed: the role paragraph (ARC/QE/PM), the explanation of `status` meanings, the reference to revision and retirement procedures, and the paragraph about impact-record columns (owner Role code and confirmation result). Replaced them with one 「共通の運用」 item in the overall policy that points to the member definitions and the document metadata standard.

F001 (`vp-po-decision-readiness`): rewrote 「メタ情報と規模の決め方」 to say that the deliverable set for each `size` is determined by the catalog template (`dct-*-template.yaml`) `min_size` and that scaffold includes entries whose `min_size` is at most `size` or unset. Verified against `meetsSize` in `src/catalog/scaffold.ts`.
The deliverable `dct-index.yaml` was not changed. The recipe is `not-needed`. No sample or template change was found necessary. No gaps were found in the common sources.
